description: Rust command line tool using Tokio and Clap

files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = 'rust-parser'
version = '0.1.0'
edition = '2021'

[dependencies]
clap = { version = '4.4', features = ['derive'] }
tokio = { version = '1.35', features = ['full'] }

# Rust Parser
Async command line parser written in Rust using Tokio and Clap.

important_facts: Uses Clap for command line argument parsing
